Factions Media Applications.Description: Click here to apply for Media Rank on Factions!
Factions Media Applications.Message:
**Media Rank Requirements**:
- Must have at least 2 videos or 1 stream on the Minecadia network, 1 being within 2 weeks of application date.
- Applicants must have a clean punishment history (last 6 weeks).
- Screenshot of video/stream statistics must be provided showing viewership and its audience/sourcing. 
- Quality of video & its content will be under consideration

**Subscriber/Followers & Views Requirements:**
<:youtube:1162951317967347752> **YouTube**: 500 Subscribers, 750 Average Views, Must have 1 video on Minecadia, Must be a recent video from within the last two weeks.
<:twitch:1162951335927361536> **Twitch/Kick**: 300 Followers, 15 Average Views, 1 Prior Stream, Must have one recent stream from within the last two weeks
📸 **TikTok/YouTube Shorts**: 1,000 Followers, 3,000 Minimum Views per TikTok, Must have 3 prior TikToks on the server

SMP Media Applications.Description: Click here to apply for Media Rank on SMP!
SMP Media Applications.Message:
**Media Rank Requirements**:
- 15 average viewers on stream.
- 5,000 views on a long-form YouTube video.
- 10,000 views on a YouTube Short or TikTok.
- Must have `smp.minecadia.com` on screen.
- Video/Stream must be on Minecadia.
- Content must be uploaded within 30 days.

*Note: Media rank lasts for 30 days.*

Player Reports.Description: Report cheaters and rule breakers on factions
Player Reports.Message:
Please make sure to read our Report Clarifications Rules
 
**Video Evidence**
All video clips need to have evidence of the players being in the faction they are accusing.
All video evidence needs to contain the Minecadia scoreboard.
All video evidence must be the entire Minecraft window.
All video evidence must be reported within 24 hrs of the offending player, if not the video evidence is considered inapplicable.
All video evidence must include your ms/ping.
All video evidence must be at least 30 seconds long.

Revive Request.Description: Get your items back if you died in an unfair way
Revive Request.Message:
Please read our revive rules to ensure you're eligible for a revive.
 
**Revive Rules**
- If your pre-pearl does not land you will not get revived. (pre-pearling is at your own risk)
-# Eternal Pearls are the only exception.
- You do not get revived for logging/lagging out in combat due to client sided issues.
- You cannot have nickname hider on
- Block glitches are NOT revivable
- Videos must be from YOUR POV
- You can only be revived for someone cheating **IF** it is your own POV and the evidence **MUST** show at least 3 spins.
-# Evidence of players cheating after your fight is not accepted.
- If you die from a server bug that causes your death and have evidence of such you are eligible for a revive.
- Any form of aim-assist present in revive evidence will be instant denied.
- The video MUST show you dying.
- The video MUST be submitted within 1 hour of the death.
- The video MUST have your scoreboard included.
- The video MUST be at least 30 seconds long with a minimum 20 seconds of actual pvp
- Allying is NOT revivable.

Rollback Request.Description: Get your items back if you died in an unfair way
Rollback Request.Message:
Please read our revive rules to ensure you're eligible for a revive.
 
**Revive Rules**
- If your pre-pearl does not land you will not get revived. (pre-pearling is at your own risk)
- Getting tp trapped does not result in a revive. However, if you report a player for /pvp trapping, and you die, you will be compensated for the lost items (provided they can be recovered)
- You do not get revived for logging/lagging out in combat.
- If you die by someone who gets banned for cheating after your death, you will not get revived. The evidence of the player cheating must be the same video of your death for a revive.
- If you die from a server bug and have evidence of your death and who picks up your items, you are eligible for a revive.
- The video **MUST** show you dying.
- The video **MUST** be submitted within 1 hour of the death.
- The video **MUST** show your ping/ms.
- The video **MUST** have your scoreboard included.
- The video **MUST** be at least 30 seconds long.
